name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.2.4.

Bills you export are always sent. A bill PDF dropped into the ASVA bills folder now goes out however old it is, and whenever you export it. Sent files move to the sent folder, and anything that could not go moves to skipped with the reason written down.

An old bill you re-export goes out as a payment reminder with the balance and a pay link, because that is usually why you are sending it again.

Fixed: customers sometimes saw "Waiting for this message" in WhatsApp. ASVA now keeps what it sent across a restart, so their phone can always fetch the message.

Bill messages are in English.
